name: Ring of Chaotic Magic
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As the minor ring of chaotic magic, except up to five levels of spells can be stored.

A remove curse cast on the wearer has a 15% chance of falling victim to the ring’s magic and result in a random spell of 1 level lower than the remove curse (2nd level for bard, cleric or paladin versions of the spell or 3rd level for the sorcerer or wizard version). If the remove curse is successfully cast, the ring loses its magical ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of spell storing

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
